Собрал ядро моста Muse: пакет `bb-plugin-muse`, чистый разбор IndexedDB, драйвер Chrome-профиля и CLI `doctor | chats | history | send | login`.

**Пути:** `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `.gitignore`, `bridge/paths.mjs`, `bridge/cache.mjs`, `bridge/session.mjs`, `bin/musebridge`, `bin/musebridge.mjs`, `tests/cache.test.mjs`, `tests/cli.test.mjs`, `tests/fixtures/side-transcript.json`, `tests/fixtures/side-chat-list.json`.

**Проверки:** `node --test tests/cache.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs` — 10/10; grep на `launchPersistentContext`, отсутствие `.cookies(` в `session.mjs` и `playwright` в `cache.mjs` — ок. Живой Muse в тестах нет.

`replyState` смотрит ассистента после выбранного user-сообщения и останавливается на следующем user, иначе в фикстуре из двух ходов «ответ на PONG» становился `42`.

```plan-fact
  {"item":2,"status":"done","evidence":["bridge/cache.mjs:17-18","tests/cache.test.mjs:41-46","cmd:node --test tests/cache.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs"]},

  {"item":4,"status":"done","evidence":["bridge/cache.mjs:57-70","tests/cache.test.mjs:86-101","tests/fixtures/side-chat-list.json","cmd:node --test tests/cache.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs"]},
  {"item":5,"status":"done","evidence":["bridge/paths.mjs:5-16","tests/cache.test.mjs:103-112","cmd:node --test tests/cache.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs"]},
  {"item":6,"status":"done","evidence":["bin/musebridge.mjs:6-20","tests/cli.test.mjs:12-18","cmd:node --test tests/cache.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs"]},
  {"item":7,"status":"done","evidence":["bridge/session.mjs:107-110","cmd:bash -c 'set -e; test -f bridge/session.mjs; grep -q launchPersistentContext bridge/session.mjs; ! grep -q \"\\.cookies(\" bridge/session.mjs; ! grep -q playwright bridge/cache.mjs'"]}
]
```

APPROACH: Чистый `cache.mjs`/`paths.mjs` на фикстурах из recon; Playwright только в `session.mjs` (`channel: chrome`, persistent profile); CLI как у zcode-лаунчера, без живых вызовов Muse.
LESSON: Для многоходового транскрипта «ответ на это user-сообщение» — ассистент до следующего user, а не последний ассистент во всём хвосте.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.
